card.name: Small words inside hyphenated titles
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as a, the, to, during, or Co just before a hyphen or inside a hyphenated compound or title. Often in long hyphenated names or headings where a capitalized word comes next.

modes.label: Linking word inside hyphenated name
modes.description: A small word like -a or -the sits inside a long hyphenated place name.

modes.label: Word before a hyphen in a compound
modes.description: A prefix or short word is followed by a hyphen in a term like Co-Administered or Ready-to-Use.

modes.label: Words in headings or URLs
modes.description: A short word in a title or file path, or a quote mark before a capitalized title.

card.writes: It promotes pieces that begin with a hyphen or period plus a capital letter, and suppresses single capital letters after a space.
card.plain: It marks small words inside hyphenated names and titles, where a hyphen or capitalized word usually comes next.
